name: custom-email-sender
description: Cognito CustomEmailSender trigger for ACCELERATE Tanzania (docs/specs/auth/forgot-password-delivery). T-2: the two message bodies — plain JavaScript ESM, no build step (design.md DD-1b). T-4 (this change): index.mjs — decrypt (AWS Encryption SDK against the CustomEmailSenderKey), route by triggerSource, validate the recipient before publishing, build via messages.mjs, publish over AMQP to the OneCGIAR notification microservice (design.md §3, §5, DD-3a/DD-3b), and the SAM resource in ../../template.yaml. `sam build`'s built-in nodejs npm installer (BuildMethod: nodejs24.x, see the CustomEmailSender build convention comment above Resources: in ../../template.yaml) installs the dependencies below into the deployed artifact — none of the three is bundled in the Lambda Node.js runtime.
